# PacLights

> > PacLights provides commercial and industrial LED lighting solutions including high bay fixtures, flood lights, and specialized lighting for warehouses, sports facilities, and hazardous locations.

PacLights manufactures and distributes LED lighting products with product lines including FHUW/FHUS high bay series, FLHQ/FLHE/FLHB linear high bays, FVTA vapor tight fixtures, and FFHL/FFHE/FFLE flood lights. The site features educational resources on LED technology, installation guides, lighting comparisons, and local warehouse retrofit case studies across the United States.

## Key Topics

- LED high bay lighting
- Warehouse lighting retrofits
- FHUW and FHUS series high bays
- FLHQ, FLHE, and FLHB linear high bay fixtures
- FVTA vapor tight high bays
- FFHL, FFHE, and FFLE flood lights
- Industrial and commercial lighting
- Energy efficiency and savings
- Color Rendering Index (CRI)
- LED vs halogen comparison
- Hazardous location lighting
- Sports field lighting standards
- Outdoor canopy lights
- Lighting retrofit solutions

## LED Lighting Guides

- [Industrial LED lightings: why are they important?](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/importance-of-industrial-led-lighting): Overview of industrial LED benefits including CRI and CCT standards
- [LED vs. Halogen Flood Light: Which One Is Best?](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/led-vs-halogen-flood-light-which-one-is-best): Comparison guide for LED vs halogen flood lights covering efficiency & cost
- [Flood Lights vs. Spotlights: What's the Difference?](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/flood-lights-vs-spotlights-whats-the-difference): Educational guide comparing flood lights and spotlights beam patterns
- [What Are retrofit LEDs?](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/what-are-retrofit-leds): Guide explaining LED retrofit bulbs and lighting upgrade solutions

## Installation and Safety

- [10 Common Mistakes to Avoid When Installing Outdoor LED Canopy Lights](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/installing-outdoor-led-canopy-lights): Installation guide covering common LED canopy light setup mistakes
- [Why You Should Buy Hazardous Lighting for Commercial Safety](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/buy-hazardous-lighting-for-safety): Guide on hazardous location lighting for commercial safety compliance
- [Lighting your outdoor industrial Pathways: Perfect Solutions](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/lighting-your-outdoor-industrial-pathways-perfect-solutions): Industrial pathway lighting guide featuring bollards and motion sensors

## Specialized Applications

- [Football Field Lighting Standards Explained](https://www.paclights.com/learning-center/football-field-lighting-standards-explained): Sports field lighting standards guide covering NFL illumination requirements
